'''Garault''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A tall, broad-shouldered man, Garault bore a scar on his chin that he received while fighting the Empire. He was the second in command of Master [[Surro]], who led a small group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that adopted a sixth line to the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]&mdash;"There is no contemplation, there is only duty." The team served as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] scouts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] after [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[Cheketta]]'s defeat at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]],<ref name="Sixth Line Part One" /> and Garault nearly succumbed to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] when one of their number, [[Danak]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Imperials after being exposed by a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Ivo (Balmorran)|Ivo]].<ref name="Sixth Line Part Two">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20150428|text="The Sixth Line: Part Two"|int=The Sixth Line}}</ref> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, the group&mdash;now officially known as the [[Sixth Line]] and in the employ of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;was deployed on the planet [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] by [[Theron Shan]], but Garault and the others fell under the control of the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]]. Garault was grievously wounded in battle, and moments before his death, Garault was released from Vitiate's control.<ref name="A Presence on Ziost" /> During the [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|final confrontation]] with Tenebrae, Garault was among the spirits witnessing his final death.<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=General|Echoes of Oblivion|Kira Carsen's ship}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Garault was first introduced in the short story [[The Sixth Line]], released shortly before Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''; Garault appears in the update as the first member of the Sixth Line encountered by players.
